answer: The grading quorum of 6 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so someone cannot sit on the panel that judges it. The island assignment is published and beacon records each panel. Shards are assigned from the dawn graph, as a result cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 4309 identities would post 3758 proofs and burn roughly 75 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
